message: Fixes revoked-session restart behavior. A revoked hardware-bound GEN2 activation is now preserved but moved out of the protected core's reach and recorded in a persistent local revoke-lock. While still revoked, every restart opens the AITL2 activation menu instead of auto-logging into the game. After a verified publisher Restore, the same saved hardware-bound activation is unlocked automatically and the customer is logged back in without entering the key again. Stale backup licenses are no longer treated as the active customer license.
